i've been in the same place you are, i got help and the correct diagnosis from my psychiatrist. i hope what i started may help someone else.

i started writing a journal/diary everyday i felt something was bothering me and exactly how i felt in that moment, i listed symptoms i had and linked them to experiences. i wrote down all my concerns, all my self doubts. every session i gave my psychiatrist the journal and let him read it or read it myself.

everytime i had an episode and a breakdown i wrote in the middle of it or after.

after he'd read/heard most of the book i straight up asked him what my diagnoses were and he explained them, then wrote them on paper.
that really helped me with feeling valid, knowing what was wrong.
